articles.title: Crypto’s CLARITY Act faces partisan fight over ethics on Senate floor
articles.snippet: While Senator Tim Scott touted yesterday’s markup as bipartisan, just two Democratic senators supported the bill, and no Democratic amendments were adopted.

articles.title: Kimi WebBridge Lets AI Agents Drive Your Browser—And Keep Your Data Local
articles.snippet: Moonshot AI just shipped a browser extension that hands the wheel to AI agents. It clicks, scrolls, fills forms, and navigates your Chrome or Edge—without sessions ever leaving your machine.

articles.title: ChatGPT Is Losing Ground to Rivals—Here Are Some Numbers
articles.snippet: ChatGPT's web traffic share is falling while its rivals are rising—just as businesses start to look beyond OpenAI.
